title: Part 2 — reviewed is not tested
description: Series Part 2: what a newsroom can do (screenshots and emails, not the direct messages) vs what only an investigation can do (warrants, chain of custody, metadata).
alt_text: Dark card, part 2 of 3. “Reporters reviewed the evidence.” That ends the inquiry — it should begin it. Green box: what a newsroom can do — read screenshots and emails; by their own account they could not review the direct messages. Amber box: what only an investigation can do — phone data, app records, message metadata, under warrant and chain of custody. Amber italic: digital evidence is testable — that is the point of it.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
